entries.dao_context: Jito DAO, JTO + JitoSOL tokens, Cryptoeconomics subDAO (CSD) operating under JIP-17 multisig. Fetched 2026-04-22.
entries.triage_summary: JIP-26 requests 50,000 JitoSOL transferred to the existing CSD 4/6 multisig (per JIP-17) to extend funding for JTO buybacks targeting ~100% of Jito Network revenue (~$12.5m), plus Vault, TWAP, and JTO Auction development. Reporting is quarterly; outputs MIT-licensed.

entries.dao_context: Jito DAO, JTO + JitoSOL tokens, BAM (Block Assembly Marketplace) adoption via tiered directed-staking. Depends on JIP-27. Fetched 2026-04-22.
entries.triage_summary: JIP-28 extends Jito's Directed Staking (JIP-27) with BAM-specific eligibility and tiered JitoSOL delegation that activates as BAM stakeweight crosses thresholds. No direct DAO expenditure. Requests six-month temporary control of Steward parameters with auto-revocation. Depends on JIP-27 passing.

entries.dao_context: Jupiter DAO, JUP token, Feb 2026 vote bundling three emission sources (Jupuary airdrop, team vesting, Mercurial stakeholders). Fetched 2026-04-22.
entries.triage_summary: Jupiter DAO 'Net-Zero Emissions' bundles three mechanisms into one binary vote (Feb 17–21, 2026): return 700M Jupuary tokens to a Community Cold Multisig, pause team on-chain vesting in favor of balance-sheet 'JUP credits', and offset accelerated Mercurial vesting via treasury buybacks tracking ~300 wallets. ASR (50M/qtr) unchanged.

entries.dao_context: Marinade Finance DAO, MNDE token, two-stage opinion-then-execute vote on burning 5-50% of MNDE total supply (fetched 2026-05-04)
entries.triage_summary: MIP-14 proposes a two-stage vote to burn 5-50% of MNDE total supply from the DAO treasury (~564M MNDE / 56.4% of 1B fixed cap). Opinion vote selects the percentage; Marinade Foundation Council multisig executes onchain. Outcome: community selected 30% (300M MNDE) burn.

entries.dao_context: Marinade Finance DAO, MNDE + mSOL tokens, protocol-fee reallocation proposal post-MIP-11 (fetched 2026-04-22)
entries.triage_summary: MIP-17 proposes pausing MIP-11 MNDE buybacks and instead retaining 100% of protocol performance fees in the DAO treasury, minting mSOL from those SOL fees for deployment into MNDE/mSOL liquidity pools per MIP-16. Pause takes effect one epoch after approval; outstanding TWAP orders complete.

entries.dao_context: Marinade Finance DAO, MNDE + mSOL tokens, fee-structure revision following SAM experience (fetched 2026-04-22)
entries.triage_summary: MIP-18 revises Marinade's fee structure: removes the fixed 9.5% performance fee, replaces it with a conditional fee charged only when Marinade APY exceeds the Solana Staking Rate (inflation + tx + priority fees, MEV excluded), and unifies a 20 bps unstake fee across Native, mSOL, and Select. No treasury disbursement.

entries.dao_context: Marinade Finance DAO, MNDE + mSOL tokens, SAM (Stake Auction Marketplace) parameter + mechanism update (fetched 2026-05-04)
entries.triage_summary: MIP-19 updates Marinade's SAM with four changes: bid-based stake-priority ordering, a Bond Risk Reduction Mechanism, removal of the unused MNDE Enhanced Stake feature, and raising per-validator cap from 4% to 15% of TVL via at-least-two rollout rounds executed by Marinade Labs. No treasury spend.
